On March 17, 2024, JWST observed the star HD 55677 using its NIRCam instrument and the F480M filter (proposal 4496). The raw detector readout from the NRCALONG array was captured, though what that signal reveals about the star's properties is still an open question. Without calibrated flux measurements or published analysis, interpreting the observation's science return is not yet possible.
